instruction: Navigate to the page about driver's license testing requirements

metadata.explanation: Task requires user to navigate from Virginia DMV homepage to the driver's license testing page. Evaluator checks if the final URL matches the expected pattern for testing or tests pages. Uses existing getter (get_active_url_from_accessTree) and metric (is_expected_url_pattern_match).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter extracts the correct state: active tab URL from Chrome's accessibility tree
Metric performs correct comparison: regex pattern matching on the URL
Complete coverage: evaluator checks the single requirement (navigation to testing page)
Expected value is semantically correct: regex pattern accurately captures Virginia DMV license testing pages (both /testing and /applying/tests paths)
Practical feasibility confirmed: getter can access accessibility tree and extract URL; metric can perform regex matching
No postconfig needed: URL verification doesn't require preserving UI state
goto_prefix handling is correct: config uses 'https://www.' but regex allows optional 'www.'
